# cryptoler

> Browser games and web projects by Axel Jönsson, an indie developer who publishes as cryptoler.

## Projects

- [cryptoler homepage](https://www.cryptoler.net/): The project directory.
- [nibblet](https://nibblet.cryptoler.net/): A cozy pixel-art fishing game in the browser.
- [Nobody's Meadow](https://meadow.cryptoler.net/): A cozy browser cooking game. Forage by day and cook by firelight.
- [Noctiluca](https://boids.cryptoler.net/): An ambient JavaScript boids simulation with bioluminescent organisms and sound.

## Optional

- [The Eye](https://eye.cryptoler.net/): A realtime chat that closed on October 23, 2026. Its public channel is archived.
- [Ödemark](https://odemark.cryptoler.net/): An unfinished, private field journal.
